redeployment.description: Does this repository accept redeployment of the same artifact version.
redeployment.title: Redeployment

preserveSnapshots.description: By default, Reposilite deletes deprecated build files, including snapshots cached through mirrored repositories. If you'd like to preserve them, set this property to true.
preserveSnapshots.title: Preserved snapshots

oneOf.description: Local file system (disk) storage provider settings
oneOf.title: File system Storage Provider

quota.description: Control the maximum amount of data stored in this repository. Supported formats: 90%, 500MB, 10GB (optional, by default: unlimited)
quota.title: Quota

mount.description: Use custom directory to locate the repository data (optional, by default it's './repositories/{name}')
mount.title: Mount

accessKey.description: Overwrite AWS access-key used to authenticate (optional)
accessKey.title: Access Key

secretKey.description: Overwrite AWS secret-key used to authenticate (optional)
secretKey.title: Secret Key

signer.description: Select the request signer implementation. LEGACY_V4 is required by Cloudflare R2 (optional)
signer.title: Signer

prefix.description: Optional prefix prepended to all object keys, e.g. to scope data within a bucket shared with other services
prefix.title: Key Prefix

sharedBucket.description: Namespace objects under the repository name so several repositories can share one bucket (optional)
sharedBucket.title: Shared Bucket

metadataCacheSettings.description: Local metadata cache settings (optional). The default is no caching. NOTE: This cache is local only. If you run multiple instances, they will not share the cache!
metadataCacheSettings.title: Local Metadata Cache

expireAfterAccessSeconds.description: Expire cache entries after the specified number of seconds since last read access
expireAfterAccessSeconds.title: Expire After Access

expireAfterCreationSeconds.description: Expire cache entries after the specified number of seconds since the initial download
expireAfterCreationSeconds.title: Expire After Creation

downloadRedirect.description: Send downloads to short-lived presigned S3 URLs instead of streaming them through Reposilite. OFF always streams, AUTO redirects only the clients listed in AUTO Redirect User Agents, ALWAYS redirects every client.
downloadRedirect.title: Download Redirect

downloadRedirectValiditySeconds.description: Validity window of presigned download URLs in seconds (optional)
downloadRedirectValiditySeconds.title: Download Redirect Validity

indexSettings.description: Serve directory listings from a local index instead of S3 LIST requests. S3 stays the source of truth.
indexSettings.title: Listing Index

enabled.description: Enable the listing index for this repository?
enabled.title: Enabled

serveMetadata.description: Also serve file size and modification time from the index instead of asking S3.
serveMetadata.title: Serve Metadata

reconciliationIntervalSeconds.description: Interval between index reconciliations with S3 in seconds
reconciliationIntervalSeconds.title: Reconciliation Interval

storageProvider.description: The storage type of this repository.
storageProvider.title: Storage provider

storagePolicy.description:
Defines how Reposilite should handle requests to repository with configured mirrored repositories.
PRIORITIZE_UPSTREAM_METADATA - try to fetch the latest version of the artifact from the remote repository
STRICT - prioritize cached version over upstream metadata (full offline mode)
storagePolicy.title: Storage policy

metadataMaxAge.description:
Fetching metadata files with PRIORITIZE_UPSTREAM_METADATA may be slow, so you can use dedicated TTL threshold for them.
If set to "0" then a fetch is done always. (Default: 0 seconds)
metadataMaxAge.title: Max age of metadata file

resolutionCacheMaxEntries.description:
Caches routing decisions for metadata reads (maven-metadata.xml, *.pom, *.module, Ivy XML) to speed up repeated requests. The cache never retains more than this number of entries. As a rough estimate, 1 MB of JVM heap can hold around 3,000 entries:
0 - disabled (no mirrors, or caching not needed)
128 - proxying a small fixed set of artifacts (single vendor SDK, internal repos)
512 - proxying focused ecosystems (BOM + transitives, a few curated mirrors)
2048+ - proxying broad ecosystems like Maven Central
(Default: 0)
resolutionCacheMaxEntries.title: Resolution cache size

reference.description: Either the id of other local repository or the URL of a remote repository.
reference.title: Link

store.description: Reposilite can store proxied artifacts locally to reduce response time and improve stability.
store.title: Store

allowedGroups.description: Allowed artifact groups. If none are given, all artifacts can be obtained from this mirror.
allowedGroups.title: Allowed Groups

blockedGroups.description: Artifact groups that are never requested from this mirror. Takes precedence over Allowed Groups. Matched as a path prefix, so 'com.acme' also blocks 'com.acmecorp' - prefer the most specific group you can.
blockedGroups.title: Blocked Groups

allowedExtensions.description: List of accepted file extensions. If none are given, all files can be obtained from this mirror. Use the special value '<none>' to permit files without an extension (e.g. native binaries).
allowedExtensions.title: Allowed Extensions

connectTimeout.description: How long Reposilite can wait for establishing the connection with a remote host. (In seconds)
connectTimeout.title: Connect Timeout

readTimeout.description: How long Reposilite can read data from remote proxy. (In seconds)
readTimeout.title: Read Timeout

authorization.description: The authorization credentials used to access mirrored repository.
authorization.title: Mirror Credentials

login.description: Login or custom header name to use
login.title: Login

password.description: Raw password or header value used by HTTP client to connect to the given repository
password.title: Password

httpProxy.description:
Custom proxy configuration for HTTP/SOCKS client used by Reposilite to connect to the mirrored repository. Examples:
HTTP 127.0.0.1:1081
SOCKS 127.0.0.1:1080 login password
httpProxy.title: HTTP Proxy

authenticatedFetchingOnly.description:
Whether to require an authenticated connection before fetching uncached artifacts from the remote repository.
_This should only ever be turned on in conjunction with the store option or with a secondary mirror host that has this option turned off.
If you are looking to hide this mirror from unauthenticated connections, please use repository visibility options instead._
authenticatedFetchingOnly.title: Authenticated Fetching Only

proxied.description: List of mirrored repositories associated with this repository.
proxied.title: Mirrored repositories

parallelMetadataLookup.description: Probe mirrors concurrently for Maven metadata and route later requests through the first matching mirror. Requires the resolution cache to be enabled.
parallelMetadataLookup.title: Parallel metadata lookup

resolutionCacheLevel.description: PINNING remembers the mirror serving metadata. NEGATIVE_CACHING also caches exact metadata misses from mirrors until eviction or invalidation.
resolutionCacheLevel.title: Resolution cache level

downloadRedirectUserAgents.description: User-Agent substrings (case-insensitive) that get presigned redirects from S3 repositories in AUTO mode. An empty list streams every request.
downloadRedirectUserAgents.title: AUTO Redirect User Agents
